summary: Kaixin Holdings furnished a Form 6-K reporting unaudited first-half 2026 results and confirming 45,278,552 ordinary shares outstanding (42,133,884 Class A; 3,144,668 Class B). Revenue rose 602% to US$667,000 on Hong Kong car sales, but gross profit fell 76% to US$23,000; operating loss narrowed 77% to US$2.0 million and net loss attributable was US$1.9 million. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. The filing is incorporated into the Form F-3 shelf registration, creating potential resale overhang; watch share-count creep and continued cash burn.
